verdict.rationale: Fireflies advertises a "Rules Engine" of admin automation workflows, but the evidence scopes it to meeting access and privacy control rather than general event-to-action rules. Broader event-driven automation relies on webhooks that fire when transcription completes, plus Zapier to fetch transcripts, so it needs external tooling. Missing for 10: documentation of the Rules Engine's rule syntax, triggers and actions; native rules beyond access/privacy; a broader catalog of event types; independent or hands-on corroboration.
